title: Weak two-function hypercontractivity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $r,s\in[0,1]$, and let $0\leq\rho\leq\sqrt{rs}$. For functions $f,g$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, take a uniformly random sign vector $X$ and form $Y$ by independently keeping each coordinate of $X$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise. Then $\mathbb{E}[f(X)g(Y)]\leq \|f\|_{1+r}\|g\|_{1+s}$, where both norms are with respect to the uniform measure on the sign cube, iterated over its $n$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
